name: Google Ads Validation Work
body:
> Audit · 2026-05-29

# Summary
A two-day, read-only Google Ads audit across all three TAG sub-accounts (May 27 to 29, 2026), done through the Google Ads MCP and read-only GHL tokens. Nothing was changed in Google Ads, GHL, GTM or any website. The master write-up is `MASTER_SUMMARY_2026-05-28_to_29.md`.

# Headline finding
Every sub-account had broken on-site conversion tracking with the same root cause: the contact form is a GoHighLevel iframe. The submit happens inside the iframe on another domain, so the parent page's Ads tag never sees it. Tags kept loading, so impressions and clicks looked normal while bidding lost its conversion signal.

| Account | Last on-site conversion | Days silent (May 29) | L30 spend |
|---|---|---|---|
| Summit | Apr 8 to 10 | 51 | $930 (Navien Tankless, 0 conversions) |
| Alphalete | Apr 29 | 30 | $1,671 (6 conversions, all uploads) |
| Pipeliners | May 11 | 18 | $2,939 (2 conversions) |

About $5,500 of L30 spend was running without a working conversion signal. Diagnostic signature: `last_received_request` keeps updating while `last_conversion` stops.

# Per-account findings
- **Alphalete** (`conversion_tracking_audit_2026-05-28.md`): tag AW-17950595678 loads via GTM-NN7B5MDM, but no conversion event ever fires; recent conversions were all offline uploads, then about 10 days overdue. 4 GCLID leads prepared for upload. 57 universal phrase negatives (competitor brands, DIY research starters) deduped against the existing 188-term CO Springs list; recommended "Path C": rename the empty "." shared list to "Alphalete CIPP Residential | Universal Exclusions" and attach it to both CO Springs and Denver.
- **Summit** (`summit_weekly_review_2026-05-29.md`, `summit_conversion_tracking_audit_2026-05-29.md`): First Time Phone Call and Free Estimate (309 lifetime conversions) stopped Apr 8 to 10. About $357 of $706 L7 went to research queries ("how much is a water heater", model numbers). Branded Defense was fine. Keyword work deferred until tracking is fixed. Only 2 of 19,272 GHL contacts had real GCLIDs, so the source of 157 historical "First Time Phone Call" conversions needs to be found (HousecallPro, Zapier or CallRail were guesses).
- **Pipeliners** (`pipeliners_conversion_tracking_audit_2026-05-29.md`): a codeless conversion waits for a `/thank-you/` page load that the iframe never triggers. GHL call uploads still worked at about 6 per 30 days. Three suspect negatives (`fix`, `at joint`, `pipe companies`) were verified safe to keep.

# Recommended fixes (for Kim, in the UI)
1. One GTM postMessage trigger template (documented in the Alphalete audit) applied to each account, matching the widget domain and the account's conversion ID and label.
2. Upload the catch-up CSVs (Alphalete 4 leads, Summit 2 leads).
3. Apply the Alphalete universal exclusions and 3 validated keyword unpauses.
4. Set `include_in_conversions_metric` to true where working actions were silently excluded (for example Pipeliners "Calls from ads", 165 lifetime conversions); review hidden GA4 actions that never fired; investigate Pipeliners "GHL Form Fill" silent since Dec 10, 2025.

# Lessons
- Any future GHL form rollout should include the postMessage trigger from day one.
- Read-only is the right default: a wrong Ads edit costs real money, a wrong markdown file costs nothing.

# Files in this folder (rollup)
- `MASTER_SUMMARY_2026-05-28_to_29.md`: overview and prioritized action queue.
- `conversion_tracking_audit_2026-05-28.md`, `summit_conversion_tracking_audit_2026-05-29.md`, `pipeliners_conversion_tracking_audit_2026-05-29.md`: tracking audits.
- `summit_weekly_review_2026-05-29.md`: Summit performance review.
- `alphalete_67_deferred_negatives_2026-05-29.md`, `alphalete_universal_negatives_FINAL_2026-05-29.txt`: universal exclusions decision and paste list.
- `alphalete_offline_upload_catchup_2026-05-29.md`, `summit_offline_upload_catchup_2026-05-29.md` (+ CSVs): offline upload catch-up (contain lead identifiers; not copied here).
- `pipeliners_suspect_negatives_2026-05-28.md`: negatives sanity check.
- `keyword_validation_2026-05-27.csv`, `negative_validation_2026-05-27.csv`, `verbatim_negatives_*`, `final_validated_*`, `new_keywords_*`: validation data and copy-paste lists (folded into this note).
- `ghl_raw\`: raw GHL contact exports (personal data, not opened).
- EOD reports in the folder are covered by [EOD Reports Index](lib:brain-eod-reports-index).
